message:
Skip the RSVP spreadsheet.

Each household gets its own private link to accept or decline, name everyone coming, choose a meal and note allergies. No account needed to reply. You see who's coming and who hasn't answered, and you can send polite reminders in one click.

Free for couples:

https://bridalteam.com/wedding-rsvp?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-11&utm_content=2026-11-11-pm-rsvp
